items.title: Introducing Smithy IDL 2.1
items.summary: Today, we are excited to announce Smithy IDL 2.1. With Smithy 2.1, you can use three new syntax features: inline collection declarations for lists and maps, tagged string literals for values that carry their own escaping rules, and a shorthand for declaring the wire order of a structure’s members.
